concepts.name: checking_capture_must_survive_reply
concepts.trigger: a checking or forcing capture places the attacking piece on a square where the opponent king or a nearby defender can immediately recapture safely
concepts.value_adjustment: strongly penalize the forcing move unless it wins clear net material or creates a forced continuation; scale penalty by sacrificed piece value and recapture certainty
concepts.why: multiple checking captures gained initiative for one move but immediately lost the moved piece and reversed material progress

concepts.name: high_value_capture_requires_recapture_audit
concepts.trigger: a queen/rook capture enters a contested square with immediate opponent recapture available
concepts.value_adjustment: apply a pre-move net-material checkpoint: penalize entries where best opponent recapture erases the gain; reward alternatives that keep the high-value piece defended or preserve the gain after one full reply cycle
concepts.why: large swings occurred when high-value captures were followed by direct recapture, causing abrupt material loss

concepts.name: quiet_development_needs_tactical_safety_gate
concepts.trigger: a non-forcing developing move leaves a piece or central point immediately capturable by a lower-risk opponent reply
concepts.value_adjustment: penalize development that increases immediate tactical liability; reward preparatory moves that add defenders, reduce attacker access, or delay development until the target is protected
concepts.why: seemingly normal piece development was punished by immediate tactical capture, turning position value downward

concepts.name: when_ahead_and_low_on_time_choose_low_variance_lines
concepts.trigger: side has a measurable material edge but remaining clock is low or sequence complexity is rising
concepts.value_adjustment: increase preference for fast-to-verify, material-preserving moves and simplifications; penalize speculative forcing lines and sacrificial checks that require deep calculation
concepts.why: the game reached a winning material phase but was not converted and ended by time loss, indicating poor risk/time tradeoff
